title: Spoken English AI Product Requirements Document
author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Installable PWA
requirements.description: The learner web product must be installable as a Progressive Web App.
requirements.rationale: Installation provides app-like repeat access without separate native applications.
acceptance_criteria: A supported browser can install the product and launch it in standalone display mode.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Individual learner product
requirements.description: The MVP serves individual learners through a private learner experience.
requirements.rationale: The commercial MVP is focused on direct learner practice.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated learners can access only their own profile, practice and progress data.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Female Indian-English tutor
requirements.description: Provide one configurable female Indian-English tutor.
requirements.rationale: Learners require a clear tutor choice.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one enabled female Indian-English MVP tutor is available by configuration.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Male Indian-English tutor
requirements.description: Provide one configurable male Indian-English tutor.
requirements.rationale: Learners require a clear tutor choice.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one enabled male Indian-English MVP tutor is available by configuration.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Tutor selection
requirements.description: Learners select an enabled tutor during onboarding.
requirements.rationale: Tutor agency improves learner comfort.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding persists the learner's valid selected tutor.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Tutor change
requirements.description: Learners can change their selected tutor in Settings.
requirements.rationale: Preferences can change after onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Settings validates and persists a replacement enabled tutor.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Animated 2D avatars
requirements.description: Tutor visuals use honest animated 2D avatar states.
requirements.rationale: Visible conversational state supports engagement without overstating maturity.
acceptance_criteria: The UI exposes accessible idle, listening, processing, thinking, speaking, encouragement, correction and error states with reduced-motion support.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Voice conversation
requirements.description: Learners can conduct consent-aware spoken practice with a text fallback.
requirements.rationale: Speaking practice is the core learner outcome.
acceptance_criteria: A user action and active consent gate bounded microphone capture, and deterministic tests require no live provider.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Grammar correction
requirements.description: Conversation feedback provides concise grammar corrections.
requirements.rationale: Actionable corrections improve communication.
acceptance_criteria: Each eligible practice response can return a correction and privacy-safe explanation.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Vocabulary coaching
requirements.description: Conversation feedback suggests useful vocabulary.
requirements.rationale: Contextual vocabulary expands learner expression.
acceptance_criteria: Eligible responses return bounded vocabulary suggestions relevant to the conversation.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Pronunciation guidance
requirements.description: Provide clearly labelled pronunciation guidance through a provider-neutral boundary.
requirements.rationale: Learners need speaking guidance without misleading acoustic claims.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic guidance is labelled non-acoustic until a validated production assessment provider is approved.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Optional Telugu explanation
requirements.description: Learners can request or enable concise Telugu explanations.
requirements.rationale: Native-language support helps resolve difficult corrections.
acceptance_criteria: Telugu explanation is optional, persisted as a preference, and rendered only when requested or enabled.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Conversation memory
requirements.description: The tutor retains bounded learner context across practice turns.
requirements.rationale: Continuity enables coherent coaching.
acceptance_criteria: Only approved learner context is retained and supplied through privacy-safe provider boundaries.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Daily practice
requirements.description: Provide a clear daily speaking lesson and practice entry point.
requirements.rationale: A repeatable routine supports learning consistency.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated learner can open and complete the deterministic daily-practice flow.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Progress
requirements.description: Learners can review practice progress.
requirements.rationale: Visible outcomes motivate continued practice.
acceptance_criteria: The progress view reports owner-scoped completed sessions and practice minutes.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Streaks
requirements.description: Track consecutive learner practice days.
requirements.rationale: Streaks make consistency visible.
acceptance_criteria: Streak calculation is deterministic, timezone-aware, and owner-scoped.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Subscription-ready architecture
requirements.description: Use provider-independent plans, entitlements and usage limits.
requirements.rationale: Commercial tiers must not couple learning logic to a payment vendor.
acceptance_criteria: Features resolve through server-side entitlements and retain accessible core learning and privacy controls.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Secure authentication
requirements.description: Protect learner access with secure account and token lifecycle controls.
requirements.rationale: Learner data requires authenticated owner isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Authentication includes hashed passwords, short-lived access tokens, rotated refresh tokens, logout, throttling and privacy-safe failures.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Payments
requirements.description: Support approved commercial payment processing through a provider adapter.
requirements.rationale: A sellable product needs a governed path from payment state to entitlements.
acceptance_criteria: Verified idempotent provider events update subscriptions without exposing payment data to learning services.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Privacy
requirements.description: Enforce consent, minimization, ownership, retention and deletion controls.
requirements.rationale: Learner speech and identity data are sensitive.
acceptance_criteria: Voice and learner data are processed only under explicit policy, bounded retention and owner-scoped access.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Production monitoring
requirements.description: Provide production health, metrics, audit and incident signals.
requirements.rationale: Commercial reliability requires observable operations.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness, structured privacy-safe telemetry, durable audit events and actionable service indicators are defined before deployment.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

requirements.title: Indian English only
requirements.description: The MVP enables Indian English only.
requirements.rationale: A focused accent scope matches the initial learner market and evaluation evidence.
acceptance_criteria: All enabled MVP tutors and browser voice configuration use Indian English; other accents remain disabled.
requirements.author: ASCOS Product Management

revision_history.reason: Approved requirements consolidated as the official MVP baseline.
Spoken English MVP requirements frozen for traceable implementation governance.
